description: This file defines the PipelineElement interface, which models an element in a processing pipeline with methods for transitioning between states (resolved, unresolved, deleted), evaluation via visitors, and utility functions for creating and combining pipeline elements.

classes.name: PipelineElement
classes.description: An interface representing an element in a processing pipeline, supporting state transitions, evaluation, and composition.

classes.name: PipelineElement.Type
classes.description: Enum defining the types of pipeline elements: DELETED, RESOLVED, UNRESOLVED.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this pipeline element.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Advances a resolved value to the next stage using a provided function.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Advances an unresolved value to the next stage using a supplier.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Advances a deleted value to the next stage using a supplier.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Evaluates the pipeline element with a visitor, returning a result.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms a resolved value into another resolved value.

methods.name: orElse
methods.description: Combines two pipeline elements, prioritizing deletion, then resolution, then unresolved states.

methods.name: toOptional
methods.description: Converts the pipeline element into an Optional<String>, conflating deletion and resolution failure.

methods.name: newVisitorBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for a visitor to evaluate pipeline elements.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Creates a pipeline element containing a resolved value.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Returns the singleton pipeline element signifying deletion.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Returns the singleton pipeline element signifying unresolved state.
